特点

  1. 招聘修复

  2. 脸部细节师- 当脸部太小时生成清晰的脸部。

  3. 细致的皮肤- 生成毛孔和皮肤细节。

  4. 所有基本型号兼容。 （SD1.5、SDXL...）

要求

  • 型号

    1. 高档：4x_NMKD-Siax_200k.pth(..\ComfyUI\models\upscale_models\)

    2. 超解剂：脸_yolov8m.pt(..\ComfyUI\models\ultralytics\bbox\)

    3. 萨姆：sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth(..\ComfyUI\models\sams\)

    4. 控制网：controlnet-tile-sdxl-1.0..safetensors（下载并重命名文件，放入路径：..\ComfyUI\models\controlnet\SDXL）

  • 自定义节点

    • 首次导入工作流程后，请使用“安装缺少的自定义节点”按钮舒适UI管理器菜单获取所需的所有节点。

温馨提示

  1. 将“Origin”和“RefineSkin”组中的Checkpoint和LoRA更改为您自己的模型。

  2. 为了获得更好的皮肤细节效果，“RefineSkin”组中的检查点应该是善于生成锐利清晰细节的模型。Juggernaut_X_RunDiffusion推荐。

  3. 根据使用的型号更改 cfg、步骤和采样器的值。

  4. 在“Efficient Loader”节点、“Origin”组中将潜在宽度和高度更改为您最喜欢的。

  5. 如果要更改角色脸部的提示，请同时编辑“Origin”组和“FaceDetailer”组中的提示。

__________________________________________________________________

    1. 4x_NMKD-Siax_200k.pth(..\ComfyUI\models\upscale_models\)

    2. 超解剂：脸_yolov8m.pt(..\ComfyUI\models\ultralytics\bbox\)

    3. 萨姆：sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth(..\ComfyUI\models\sams\)

    4. 控制网：controlnet-tile-sdxl-1.0..safetensors（下载并重命名文件，放入路径：..\ComfyUI\models\controlnet\SDXL）

    • 舒适UI管理器

Features

  1. Hires Fix

  2. Face Detailer- Generate clear face when the face is too small.

  3. Detailed Skin- Generate pores and skin details.

  4. All base model compatible. (SD1.5, SDXL...)

Requirement

  • Models

    1. Upscale:4x_NMKD-Siax_200k.pth(..\ComfyUI\models\upscale_models\)

    2. Ultralytics:face_yolov8m.pt(..\ComfyUI\models\ultralytics\bbox\)

    3. Sam:sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth(..\ComfyUI\models\sams\)

    4. Controlnet:controlnet-tile-sdxl-1.0..safetensors(download and rename the file, put it into the path: ..\ComfyUI\models\controlnet\SDXL)

  • Custom Nodes

    • After importing the workflow for the first time, please use the "Install Missing Custom Nodes" button inComfyUI Managermenu to get all the nodes needed.

Tips

  1. Change the Checkpoint and LoRAs in the Group "Origin" and "RefineSkin" to your own models.

  2. For better result of skin details, the checkpoint in Group "RefineSkin" should be a model which is good at generating sharp and clear details.Juggernaut_X_RunDiffusionis recommended.

  3. Change value of cfg, steps and sampler, depending on used models.

  4. Change the latent width and height to your favorite, in Node "Efficient Loader", Group "Origin".

  5. If you want to change the prompts about the charater's face, edit the prompts in the Group "Origin" and "FaceDetailer" at the same time.

__________________________________________________________________

    1. 4x_NMKD-Siax_200k.pth(..\ComfyUI\models\upscale_models\)

    2. Ultralytics:face_yolov8m.pt(..\ComfyUI\models\ultralytics\bbox\)

    3. Sam:sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth(..\ComfyUI\models\sams\)

    4. Controlnet:controlnet-tile-sdxl-1.0..safetensors(download and rename the file, put it into the path: ..\ComfyUI\models\controlnet\SDXL)

    • ComfyUI Manager
